visualCharacteristics: New: image-top cards with linked title, copy and a trailing arrow icon, 3 per row; the filled maroon vs white bordered look is colour scheme only, so both card grids share it.

Options: dark (maroon filled card, light text: /about-us section cards), horizontal (related-page cards; image beside text when an image is present, otherwise text-only), off-white (light filled card: /learning-and-support), highlight (accent bar on top: /learning-and-support/high-potential-and-gifted-education).
contentPattern: Repeating look-alike items (image, title, text) in a wrapping grid, each linking to a detail page.
Six look-alike linked items that wrap in a 3-column grid.

usage.description: Grid of image-top cards (3 per row on desktop), each with a linked title, short description and a trailing arrow; whole card is clickable.

reuseGuidance: Use for navigational card grids linking to detail pages (feature highlights, quick links). Card colour comes from section style.
tableStructure: One row per card: cell 1 image, cell 2 linked title + description
Options in the block name: Cards Linked Arrow (dark | horizontal | off-white | highlight); the image cell may be left empty for text-only related-page cards
